turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Alright, let's dive into this scenario. Imagine it’s 3 AM, and you’ve been trying so hard to get some sleep after feeding the baby. The house is quiet, but suddenly, your heart races as you feel the unmistakable vibration from the baby’s phone on silent mode. Your mind starts racing—was there a call? Is the baby okay? You jump out of bed, heart pounding, checking the screen to see nothing but a notification that might as well be flashing red lights. This panic attack hits you like a wave; your breath quickens, palms sweat, and you can’t help but think about all the what-ifs. Why did you even buy a baby phone in the first place? Now you’re wide awake, stressing about something that could’ve been so easily ignored if it were just a regular alarm.
